sources.institution: University of Wyoming, Casper College, Central Wyoming College, Eastern Wyoming College, Laramie County CC, Northern Wyoming CC District, Northwest College, Community College Commission (plus state agencies)
sources.system: OpenTheBooks - Wyoming state employees (third party; sourced from Wyoming State Auditor and Legislative Service Office records requests)
sources.institutions_covered: University of Wyoming and 6 community colleges plus the Commission (Western Wyoming CC not seen in the filter list), plus state agencies

sources.blocker: Third-party HTML with no export, and the browse limit is the top 10,000 rows, so the full set can't be reached by scraping.
sources.notes: Best available. OpenTheBooks may provide the full dataset on request.

sources.institutions_covered: state employees including University of Wyoming
sources.blocker: Third-party, one page per person; provenance unverified.

sources.institution: State employees (possibly incl. University of Wyoming)
sources.system: MuckRock FOIA requests to Wyoming State Auditor (public request pages with released files)
sources.institutions_covered: unclear; State Auditor payroll (UW may run its own payroll)
sources.blocker: MuckRock returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so contents and coverage could not be verified. These are one-off FOIA releases.
sources.notes: Worth a manual look: released spreadsheets may be downloadable without login.

private_extra: None (no private universities of note in Wyoming).
gaps: No official online person-level pay source for the University of Wyoming or any community college. The State Auditor's transparency site (WyOpen) covers vendor payments and excludes salaries, and wyoopen.gov did not resolve. Data has come only through Public Records Act requests.
notes: Rated OpenTheBooks C, since it's the most complete and covers UW plus the community colleges for 2017-2025 but has no export. wyoopen.gov returned DNS failure (ENOTFOUND). A 2019 news report says WyOpen excludes salaries.
